detail.longDescription: I got a cheap mini PC recently, and installed Debian on it. Then I installed Podman, and started creating and documenting how to run containers using quadlets. Here is the first (of hopefully many) uploads. This one is for Nginx Proxy Manager. https:// codeberg.org/bryanredeagle/qua dlets/src/branch/main/nginx-proxy-manager # containers # podman # quadlets # HomeLab # docker
